scope: Actual Android InputConnection, hardware Enter, native clipboard and undo

results.test: IME Enter keeps the paired closing brace at its base indent
Nested IME Enter indents the body and restores the closing brace
Continuous IME typing skips both existing nested closers
A valid closer can be skipped after caret navigation
An orphan closer receives the typed character instead of a skip
A brace in a line comment is inserted literally
A bracket inside a string is inserted literally
C++ digit separators are not paired quotes
IME Backspace removes an empty generated pair
One native undo removes a generated pair
Single-character native paste does not synthesize a mate
Multiline paste preserves its exact whitespace
IME Backspace removes indentation to the previous indent stop
Selected lines indent by the profile width
Shift-Tab removes the profile indentation
Custom two-space indentation is respected by IME Enter
Hardware Enter uses the same smart newline logic
IME Enter preserves the Windows CRLF separator
IME Enter continues documentation comments
Modern IME commitText overload uses smart Enter
Native paste normalizes mixed line breaks to the document format
Enter commits composing text without moving or duplicating it
A stale IME connection cannot insert into the new session
